The plate holds a few cauliflower florets (probably boiled or steamed) and some sliced red onion.

The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 24 cm. There are roughly 5 small florets, which I estimate at about 70 g in total. The red onion is a small pile of thin slices, perhaps 30 g.

That gives about 100 g of food overall. Cauliflower is about 25 kcal per 100 g, so 70 g is roughly 18 kcal. Onion is about 40 kcal per 100 g, so 30 g is roughly 12 kcal. The total is about 30 kcal. I'll round up to 35 kcal to allow for a little oil or dressing, though none is visible.
